design_description: A bold black and fiery orange design featuring a striking halftone flame pattern rising from the lower jersey. Large pixelated dots in vibrant red, orange and yellow create a dynamic fire effect, gradually dispersing into the clean black upper body. Thin red accents on the collar and cuffs complement the flames, while white player names, numbers and logos provide sharp contrast. The pattern continues seamlessly across the back for a cohesive, high-energy finish.
